referenceFunction.generalComment: For rail infrastructure, expenditures and environmental interventions due to construction, renewal and disposal of railway tracks have been allocated based on the train kilometric performance of an average German ICE train 417182 vkm and a life time of 40 years . For the determination of the train demand the yearly transport performance of ICE trains in Germany was used 97837945 pkm.; UUID: 6ceccef0-314d-3f59-835d-e8d7130e6e96
referenceFunction.includedProcesses: Included is the production, maintenance and disposal of high speed train as well as the construction, maintenance and disposal of the railway tracks. The energy consumption (including 5.033% losses and emission of the train operation are accounted for.
referenceFunction.name: Transport, high speed train

technology.text: For vehicle operation all technologies are included in the average data. Rail construction addresses conventional and modern ballastless beddings.

representativeness.extrapolations: Emission, extrapolated from long distance train transport in CH
